# Watts Growth Labs

> Watts Growth Labs is an invitation-led, human-led growth partnership platform for founder-led businesses, expert-led firms, and leadership teams across Western Canada and international markets. It is not open to public enrollment — partnership access begins with a request form and is extended by invitation after a fit review. Watts Growth Labs is the human-led strategy and execution layer of the Watts Group ecosystem, an AI-first Canadian consulting and investment group, and combines strategic advisory, positioning, and AI-supported growth thinking with practical delivery: high-converting websites and funnels, selective paid advertising (Google, Meta, LinkedIn), authority and content distribution, CRM and lifecycle automation, SEO foundations, and practical AI protocol deployment.

Ideal partners are high-ticket B2B service firms, expert-led consultancies, mid-sized professional service corporations (legal, engineering, logistics), and tech/SaaS companies — generally navigating a transition phase such as repositioning, expanding visibility, or deploying AI to reduce operating overhead without adding headcount. Founded by Ritesh Watts.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://wattsgrowthlabs.com/): Single-page site — the invitation model, who this is for, what partnership may include, the Watts Group ecosystem, the request process, and FAQ.
- [Request Access](https://wattsgrowthlabs.com/#final-cta): Application form — the only path into partnership; no self-serve public enrollment.
- [FAQ](https://wattsgrowthlabs.com/#faq): What Watts Growth Labs is, why it operates invitation-led, ideal partner profile, onboarding structure, and how its AI deployment differs from generic automation tools.

- [Watts Group](https://wattsgroup.in): The parent AI-first Canadian consulting and investment group.
